title: apricity-cli: --collection on export --clips, with help, errors and docs (tools, glossary, curation note)
description:
## Intent

The command, and its documentation.

## Scope

- `--collection <name>` with `--clips` on `apricity export` (crates/apricity-cli/src/export.rs); requires `--library`; `-o` (default `./clips`), `--force`.
- `--help` line and example; errors as in the story; success line `digs: 12 clip files, a drum rack of 7 pads`.
- Docs: docs/tools.md (the flag, in the "Exporting to a DAW" section); docs/glossary.md "Collection" if still missing; `design/curation.md` (the keep -> collection -> DAW path, next to the existing `curation crates` .apr export); `design/daw-presets.md` collection section.

## Verification

```sh
CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-cli --test export_cli
CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw --test conformance
```
All M4 scenarios green; a case-insensitive grep of docs/ and design/ for the vendor's name prints nothing.

## Release

`feat(<this task id>): apricity export --clips --collection`. Not breaking.

## Dependencies

Blocked by the rack-from-collection task.
